title: Hexagonal p6 single-cell-trail puffer
summary: A five-state puffer shifts by axial (−2,4) every six generations, depositing one stationary live cell each cycle. Exact separation certificates prove continued propagation on the infinite hexagonal lattice.

provenance.credit: Found and independently verified in this package’s bounded search; discovery priority has not been established.
provenance.note: A moving head extracted from the three-cell mixed-state seed. Its complete period-6 recurrence and permanent separation from every deposit are certified. B5 is unused in flight; the three-cell launch uses B5 twice. This is a newly verified package example, not a claim of first discovery.

title: Hexagonal three-cell twin-puffer launcher
summary: Two live cells and one refractory cell launch two opposite puffers. By generation 30 they have separated from four stationary cells; each puffer then deposits one live cell every six generations.

provenance.credit: Found and independently verified in this package’s bounded search; discovery priority has not been established.
provenance.note: Mixed-state exhaustive campaign, seed mixed-n3-c5-s10. Complete replay gives two opposite certified p6 puffers and four stationary live cells at generation 30. This is a finite launch, not a stationary gun. A related four-live-cell seed had remained unclassified in the earlier exhaustive campaign; priority outside this package is unestablished.

title: Hexagonal p48 long-cycle spaceship
summary: A four-state spaceship follows a 48-generation cycle, moving by axial (−32,16). It can also be launched from seven live cells, as recorded in the accompanying evidence.

provenance.credit: Found and independently verified in this package’s bounded search; discovery priority has not been established.
provenance.note: Seven-cell exhaustive campaign, seed n7c4s245: seven live cells settle after 16 generations into this exact period-48 ship. The displayed recurrent phase was centred for viewing. Full D6/phase comparison finds no match in the preceding 33-entry hexagonal catalogue. Independent decomposition at every phase confirms one persistent body with short-lived sparks, rather than a convoy of independently recurring ships. No worldwide priority claim is made.
